data: In fiscal 2023, Tesla reported revenue of $96,773 million and gross profit of $17,660 million, which works out to a gross margin of about 18.2%. Income from operations was $8,891 million, giving an operating margin of about 9.2%. Both margins were lower than in fiscal 2022, when revenue was $81,462 million, gross profit was $20,853 million (25.6% gross margin) and operating income was $13,656 million (16.8% operating margin). Revenue grew about 18.8% in 2023, but cost of revenues rose faster, from $60,609 million to $79,113 million, and operating expenses increased to $8,769 million from $7,197 million.
